description: A chromatic tuner with a large needle display, for reading from a distance. A red glow on the display means the detection is unreliable

params.text: Sets the frequency the tuner takes as A, which every reading is measured against
Names the notes do, re and mi rather than A, B and C
Smooths the movement of the needle
Reads low pitches accurately, from 8Hz to about 1100Hz

inputs.text: The signal whose pitch is measured

outputs.text: A copy of the signal at the input, for passing it on

notes: the display gives the note being targeted as a MIDI note tag with the deviation in cents
